stem_en:
Which of the following statements are INCORRECT?
Choose the correct answer from the options given below :

statements.label: A
statements.text: All the transition metals except scandium form MO oxides which are ionic.

statements.label: B
statements.text: The highest oxidation number corresponding to the group number in transition metal oxides is attained in $\mathrm{Sc_2O_3}$ to $\mathrm{Mn_2O_7}$.

statements.label: C
statements.text: Basic character increases from $\mathrm{V_2O_3}$ to $\mathrm{V_2O_4}$ to $\mathrm{V_2O_5}$.

statements.label: D
statements.text: $\mathrm{V_2O_4}$ dissolves in acids to give $\mathrm{VO_3^-}$ salts.

statements.label: E
statements.text: CrO is basic but $\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}$ is amphoteric.
